description: This file defines the ShufflerIterDataPipe class, a data processing component for shuffling data in a DataPipe pipeline within the PyTorch data utilities. It includes methods for shuffling, setting seeds, and serialization, and is part of the torch.utils.data.datapipes module.

classes.name: ShufflerIterDataPipe
classes.description: A data pipe class that shuffles data from a MapDataPipe by indices, returning an IterDataPipe with randomized order.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the shuffler with a MapDataPipe and optional indices.

methods.name: set_seed
methods.description: Sets the seed for random shuffling.

methods.name: __iter__
methods.description: Iterates over the data, yielding items in shuffled or original order.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the shuffling state, optionally reseeding.

methods.name: __len__
methods.description: Returns the length of the underlying datapipe.

methods.name: __getstate__
methods.description: Serializes the object state for pickling.

methods.name: __setstate__
methods.description: Restores the object state from pickling.
